description: Paired statistics scripts/compare_tta.py (design 9.3, T13; review NIT 2), additive per-subject per-label template Dice file in evaluation run (plan D6), SLURM: predict_mindboggle.sh TTA / TTA_LEVELS / SKIP_CHECKS, new tta_mindboggle.sh (one GPU job: arm A, arm B, linear-eval rigid/affine x 2 arms, template compares; prints the all-pairs and final compare lines), new compare_tta.sh (basic), tests and tests/run_tests_wsl.sh lists. Depends on FEAT-003 (linear-eval CSV layout and subcommand).
steps: 1. evaluation/evaluate.py cmd_run: after the per-label loop, write `per_subject_label.csv` with one row per subject: `subject`, then `template_dice_<label>` for every label of lab_list, from per_label[('template', i)] (NaN as written by csv for float nan). Module docstring Outputs line updated. No other output changes. tests/test_evaluation.py: in the existing method run test assert the file exists, has n rows, the label columns, and that the row means equal per_subject.csv template_dice for that subject's finite labels (mean over labels, within 1e-6) -- check M.dice_summary to confirm template_dice is the nan-mean over labels before asserting; if not, assert against the per_label.csv template means instead.

2. scripts/compare_tta.py (numpy + scipy only, TF-free, Python 3.8; module docstring = usage + the CSV layouts it reads + the scope statement): CLI `--a DIR --b DIR --out DIR [--kind eval|linear] [--label-a NAME --label-b NAME] [--n-boot 10000] [--seed 0]`. eval kind: per_subject.csv (key 'subject'), optional per_pair.csv (keys 'moving','fixed'), optional per_subject_label.csv, summary.json group metrics (centrality_mean_mm, mean_logjac_abs, atlas_intensity_std values only). linear kind: per_subject.csv / per_pair.csv of linear-eval. Subject sets (and pair sets) must match exactly, else exit 2 with the difference; missing per_subject.csv -> exit 2. Per metric (numeric columns present in both): d = B - A per subject; n, mean, median, SD, improved/worse/tied by DIRECTION (higher better: names containing dice, ncc, lncc; lower better: fold, logjac, inv_err, rms, rot, trans, scale, shear, centrality, disp); paired bootstrap CI (rng = np.random.default_rng(seed), n_boot resamples, percentile 2.5/97.5); Wilcoxon `scipy.stats.wilcoxon(d, zero_method='pratt')` with ValueError or non-finite p and all-zero d -> p 1.0, note 'all differences zero'; sign test via getattr(scipy.stats, 'binom_test', None) else scipy.stats.binomtest(k, n).pvalue (no untied subject -> p 1.0 same note); d_z = mean/SD (None when SD 0); matched-pairs rank-biserial from the ranks of |d| excluding zeros. Pair metrics (per_pair present in both): per-subject d_i = mean over pairs with i as moving image (Wilcoxon on these), CI by the subject-cluster bootstrap: D [n,n] pair differences, W [n,n] 1 for evaluated pairs (0 diagonal), counts c = bincount of rng.integers(0, n, n) per resample, estimate = c^T (W*D) c / c^T W c, vectorised over resamples in blocks (C [b, n] @ (W*D) then row-wise dot with C). Families: primary P1 template_dice, P2 pair_dice, P3 fold_fwd_pct (Holm over the available primaries; P2 marked 'needs all-pairs evaluation' when per_pair absent); secondary = all other per-subject and pair metrics (Holm within), per-label template Dice (Wilcoxon per label, Holm over labels; only when both per_subject_label.csv exist, else note 'per-label data absent'); linear kind: all metrics in one family, pair_rms_mm_mean flagged as the linear endpoint. SESOI: dice metrics 0.002, fold_fwd_pct max(0.25 * mean_A, 0.0002), linear pair_rms_mm_mean / pair_rms_mm 0.5 mm. Decision per endpoint: 'measurable impact' = Holm p < 0.05 and CI excludes 0; 'practically relevant' additionally |mean d| >= SESOI; 'no practically relevant effect' when the CI lies inside +-SESOI. Outputs: compare.json (all numbers, inputs, n_boot, seed, scipy version, scope), compare.csv (one row per metric), compare.md (scope statement of design 9.3 in the header, primary table, secondary table, per-label summary, group metrics A vs B). Exit 0 on success.

3. tests/test_compare_tta.py (TF-free, no tf_setup import): synthetic per_subject.csv pairs (n 30) with a known shift 0.01 in template_dice -> mean diff 0.01, CI covers it, Wilcoxon p < 0.05, decision text; identical inputs -> difference 0, p 1.0, note 'all differences zero' for Wilcoxon and sign test, no crash; subject-cluster bootstrap on a synthetic pair matrix with a known shift recovers it, and with a strong shared per-subject effect gives a wider CI than a naive bootstrap over pair-level values; Holm adjustment on known p values; mismatched subject sets -> exit 2; kind linear on linear-eval-style CSVs; per-label branch with and without per_subject_label.csv; an end-to-end case running `evaluation.evaluate.main(['run', ...])` twice on the tiny grid of tests/test_evaluation.py (two slightly different field sets, --pairs all) and compare_tta on the two outputs (exit 0, compare.md contains the scope statement).

4. slurm/predict_mindboggle.sh: add env docs + `TTA=${TTA:-none}`, `TTA_LEVELS=${TTA_LEVELS:-}`, `SKIP_CHECKS=${SKIP_CHECKS:-}`; `TTA_FLAGS="--tta $TTA"`; `if [ -n "$TTA_LEVELS" ]; then TTA_FLAGS="$TTA_FLAGS --tta-levels $TTA_LEVELS"; fi`; wrap steps 1a-1c in `if [ "$SKIP_CHECKS" != "1" ]; then` ... `else` `echo "checks 1a-1c skipped (SKIP_CHECKS=1; run in the TTA-none arm of the same job)"` `fi` keeping the singularity lines at column 0 and unchanged; checks stay TTA-free; step-2 line ends `--out "$FIELDS" $LEVEL_FLAGS $TTA_FLAGS $EXTRA </dev/null || exit $?`; echo of TTA in the header line. Update tests/test_slurm_scripts.py::test_predict_script for the new run-line ending and add assertions for the three env defaults, the SKIP_CHECKS message, and that no check-streaming line contains TTA_FLAGS.

5. New slurm/compare_tta.sh: #SBATCH --job-name=bgr-tta-compare, -A qtim, -p basic, -N 1, --ntasks-per-node=1, --cpus-per-task=1, --mem=4G, --time=00:15:00, --output/--error $PROJ/logs/%x-%j.{out,err}; 'DO NOT submit without Jay's approval'; set -uo pipefail; env A, B, OUT (required), KIND (default eval), REPO, SIF; `singularity exec -B /autofs -B /scratch "$SIF" bash -c 'cd "$1" && shift && python "$@"' cmp "$REPO" scripts/compare_tta.py --a "$A" --b "$B" --out "$OUT" --kind "$KIND" </dev/null`; OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL threads 1; usage examples for eval and linear kinds in the header.

6. New slurm/tta_mindboggle.sh: #SBATCH --job-name=bgr-tta-mb, -A qtim, -p rtx8000, --gpus=1, -N 1, --ntasks-per-node=1, --cpus-per-task=3, --mem=96G, --time=10:00:00, logs under $PROJ/logs; 'DO NOT submit without Jay's approval'; set -uo pipefail; env CKPT and NAME required (NAME without commas/colons), PROCESSED, GRID_REF, PARTS (default 'predict linear compare'), SEED (0), TTA_LEVELS (empty), DRY_RUN (1 = print every command, run nothing); export TMPDIR=${SCRATCH_ROOT:-/scratch}/${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}. predict part: `NAME=${NAME}_tta_none OUT=$PROJ/results/predict_mindboggle/${NAME}_tta_none TTA=none CKPT=... bash "$REPO/slurm/predict_mindboggle.sh"` (stop on non-zero), then `..._tta_flip8 TTA=flip8 TTA_LEVELS=$TTA_LEVELS SKIP_CHECKS=1`; linear part: for task in rigid affine, for arm in none flip8: singularity --nv ... predict.py linear-eval --checkpoint "$CKPT" --processed-dir "$PROCESSED" --grid-reference "$GRID_REF" --task $task --seed $SEED --tta $arm [--tta-levels] --out $PROJ/results/linear_eval_mindboggle/${NAME}_${task}_tta_${arm} </dev/null (count failures, continue); compare part: `python scripts/compare_tta.py` (inside the container, CPU) on the two eval_template dirs -> $PROJ/results/tta_compare/${NAME}_template and per task on the linear dirs -> ${NAME}_${task}_linear (--kind linear); finally echo (never run) the two all-pairs lines `METHOD=${NAME}_tta_$ARM FWD=... INV=... ATLAS=... ATLAS_SEG=... CONV="--components xyz --signs +++ --units mm" sbatch slurm/eval_mindboggle.sh` and the final `A=$PROJ/results/eval_mindboggle/${NAME}_tta_none B=$PROJ/results/eval_mindboggle/${NAME}_tta_flip8 OUT=$PROJ/results/tta_compare/${NAME}_allpairs sbatch slurm/compare_tta.sh`; exit status = number of failed parts. Header documents the order and the 2-active-job rule.

7. tests/test_slurm_scripts.py: tests for tta_mindboggle.sh (exact #SBATCH lines, no 'entre', LF only, ASCII, approval note, no line starting with sbatch, both arms with TTA=none / TTA=flip8 SKIP_CHECKS=1, four linear-eval invocations via loops, printed eval_mindboggle and compare_tta lines) and compare_tta.sh (exact #SBATCH lines incl. -p basic, --mem=4G, --time=00:15:00); a DRY_RUN=1 subprocess run of tta_mindboggle.sh with NAME/CKPT set (bash available in the env; skip if bash missing) checking that the printed commands contain both arms, 4 linear-eval lines and the compare calls; bash -n of the three scripts. tests/run_tests_wsl.sh: PYFILES += scripts/compare_tta.py; bash -n loop += slurm/tta_mindboggle.sh slurm/compare_tta.sh slurm/predict_mindboggle_multi.sh (if not already); TF-free names += tests.test_compare_tta.
8. Write .agents/tasks/tta/test-log-FEAT-004.md (commands, results, counts, the DRY_RUN output excerpt).
